test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

My father had to attend the meeting on Saturday.

options.text: The meeting has to be attended by my father on Saturday.
The meeting had been to be attended by my father on Saturday.
The meeting had been attended by my father on Saturday.
The meeting had to be attended by my father on Saturday.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **The meeting had to be attended by my father on Saturday.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** active voice.** We need to change it into** passive voice.**
 
• Whenever an infinitive (to + V1) is used in the active voice, it is changed according to the following structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - Subject + verb + to + V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice - Object + verb + to + be + V3 + by + Subject.
 
 
 
• The subject **'My father' **becomes the object of the passive voice.
 
• The object **'the meeting' **becomes the subject of the passive voice.
 
• **'to attend'** is changed to** 'to be attended'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passive Voice:**__ *The meeting had to be attended by my father on Saturday.*
